name: ticket-board
description: Your tickets/BOARD.md in a side pane: browse, sort and filter tickets, answer their open questions, flip draft to ready, create tickets that an AI writer turns into build-ready rd.md + eval.md, and hand ready tickets to the router.

ticketsDir.title: Tickets folder
ticketsDir.description: Folder (relative to the project) that holds BOARD.md and the ticket folders.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the open pane re-reads the board to pick up changes made by the router, workers or you.

autoOpen.title: Open at start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane automatically when a session starts in a project that has a ticket board (only where it can sit beside the chat).

writerModel.title: Ticket writer model
writerModel.description: Model for the AI ticket writer (for example opus or sonnet). Empty uses the session's model.
